messages:
camille: Quick postmortem follow-up. Root cause summary: simultaneous regional failover + short DNS TTLs led to retry amplification and transient TLS handshake spikes. Need owners and timelines for DNS TTLs, routing jitter, TLS backoff, and probes.

netops: I can take the DNS work. Proposal: increase edge record TTL 25s -> 100s and coordinate with registrar. Will open REG ticket and DNS PR. Target: Tue EOD.

reza: I'll own routing jitter and cooldown. Plan: add randomized instance-level failover delay (0-5s) + cluster cooldown 20s behind a feature flag. Proto in staging in 48h. PR will include rollback.

sre-oncall: I'll build a dual-region synthetic and dashboard tile for retries/min + handshake-fail %. Alert: retries/min > 2x baseline for 5m -> page. Canary start: tomorrow 08:00 UTC.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging deploy queued for PR #834 (reza).

netops: Adding runbook snippet to postmortem with rollback steps:
```
# rollback snippet
set route ttl: 100 -> 25
invalidate caches via CDN purge
revert routing.featureflags.routing_jitter to false
```

camille: Recurrence watch: ops wants weekly triage for 6 weeks. Tagging this thread as "watchwave-6w". Owners: camille weeks 1-2, netops weeks 3-4, reza weeks 5-6.

reza: Will attach PR link and staging test results once deploy finishes.

sre-oncall: Probe created: probe-watchwave-rr. Dashboard link will be posted after canary.

camille: Confirmed owners and gating: probe green + canary metrics within 10% retries delta before prod rollout. If alert fires -> rollback and page. Closing action tracker once PRs are merged and probe shows stable metrics.
